title: Required change explanations
responsibility: Finds unit additions/removals, symbol changes and otherwise-unexplained declared-manifest changes that need reasons.

inputs.name: presentUnits.side
inputs.description: Revision source index and unit manifests to filter for active units with present owned source.

inputs.name: requiredReasons.base
inputs.description: Earlier revision’s source blocks and manifests.

inputs.name: requiredReasons.head
inputs.description: Later revision’s source blocks and manifests.

inputs.name: reasonDeclarationHash.unit
inputs.description: Full or compact manifest whose declared facts need a fingerprint.

outputs.name: presentUnits
outputs.description: Map of active manifests with at least one owned path present in the source index.

outputs.name: requiredReasons
outputs.description: Sorted required reasons with unit/symbol, change kind and before/after fingerprints. Identical named blocks can move files unchanged; whole-unit changes use *, and declared-manifest changes use <manifest> only when no symbol changes already require reasons.

outputs.name: reasonDeclarationHash
outputs.description: Sixteen-character SHA-256 prefix for declared fields, or the stored fingerprint of a compact manifest.
